nativeBaseline.reference: native heading/button and associated panels; consider native details grouping

library: Own expansion relationships and applicable keyboard policy; avoid unrelated nested item registration.
consumer: Author heading levels, labels and content; choose single or multiple expansion.

notes: Item values are non-empty and unique within one root; generated trigger/panel IDs use an injective token. Nested roots do not participate in parent navigation.
A noncollapsible open trigger remains focusable with aria-disabled; native disabled items are skipped. Panel regions are opt-in to avoid excessive landmarks.

Framework header level and panel region are authored; the library owns trigger/panel IDs. Elements uses authored native headings and role=region opt-in. Multiple Elements values serialize as JSON arrays (legacy comma-separated simple values can still be read).
Audit mapping is provisional; exact-head and manual evidence remain required.
